Dis stetmɛnt bɔt di rayt we ɔlman ɔlsay na di wɔl fɔ gɛt, fɔ bi sem fɔɔl kanaba pipul dɛn na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa, fɔ mek shɔ se dnsɛf ɛn dɛn dɛnlan am, dɛn sabi am ɛn de fala wetin i se so dat ɔLoba di wɔl pipul dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis.

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt rayt, jɛs bikɔs i fil so, fɔ, mek sɔmbɔdi nɔ ebul fɔ kɔl in kɔntri in yon igen, ɛn, pantap dat, nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt da pawa de fɔ tap ɛnibɔdi we want fɔ chenj di kɔntri we i go kɔl in yon.

folded.id: fɔ tek|ɛni|pɔsin in yon prɔpati kɔmɔt na in an we i jɛs fil nɔmɔ fɔ du so
folded.subject: fɔ tek
folded.object: pɔsin in yon prɔpati kɔmɔt na in an we i jɛs fil nɔmɔ fɔ du so

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ tek ɛni pɔsin in yon prɔpati kɔmɔt na in an we i jɛs fil nɔmɔ fɔ du so.

folded.id: fɔ tink|ɛn|fɛnɔt wetin rayt ɛn rɔŋ pantap dat wi fɔ sabi aw fɔ liv lɛk wan big famili
folded.subject: fɔ tink
folded.object: fɛnɔt wetin rayt ɛn rɔŋ pantap dat wi fɔ sabi aw fɔ liv lɛk wan big famili

spans.text: Wi ɔl ebul fɔ tink ɛn fɛnɔt wetin rayt ɛn rɔŋ pantap dat wi fɔ sabi aw fɔ liv lɛk wan big famili.

folded.id: fɔ udat|dɛn|want
folded.subject: fɔ udat
folded.object: want

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ fos dɛn, nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ tap dɛn fɔ fri fɔ vot usay nɔbɔdi nɔ go si dɛn, ɛn fɔ udat dɛn want.

folded.id: fɔɔndastand wetin|dɛn|rayt ɛn dɛn fridɔm
folded.subject: fɔɔndastand wetin
folded.object: rayt ɛn dɛn fridɔm

spans.text: Fɔ mek dis wanwɔd ol wata ɔloba di wɔl, ɛvribɔdi fɔɔndastand wetin dɛn rayt ɛn dɛn fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis yaso min.

folded.id: frɔm lɔya|dɛn|we go tinap fɔ am na kotos
folded.subject: frɔm Lɔya
folded.object: we go tinap fɔ am na kotos

spans.text: ɛnibɔdi we dɛn arɛst fɔ tiŋ we i du agens di lɔ, fɔ gɛt ful protɛkshɔn frɔm Lɔya dɛn we go tinap fɔ am na kotos.

folded.id: gɛt ɔl|di|ɛp we i nid frɔm ɛni kotos we gɛt pawa na in kɔntri
folded.subject: gɛt ɔl
folded.object: ɛp we i nid frɔm ɛni kotos we gɛt pawa na in kɔntri

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi we tink se dɛn dɔn go agens in rayt we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, fɔ ebul gɛt ɔl di ɛp we i nid frɔm ɛni kotos we gɛt pawa na in kɔntri.

folded.id: go ɛnisay|ɛn|tap ɛnisay na ɛni pan di kɔntri dɛn we de na di yunaytɛd neshɔn
folded.subject: go ɛnisay
folded.object: tap ɛnisay na ɛni pan di kɔntri dɛn we de na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi gɛt rayt fɔ go ɛnisay ɛn tap ɛnisay na ɛni pan di kɔntri dɛn we de na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn; pantap dat, i fri fɔ kɔmɔt na in kɔntri ɔɛniwan pan di kɔntri dɛn na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn ɛn tɔn bak kam na in yon kɔntri we i pliz.

folded.id: i gɛt|di|raty fɔ sho
folded.subject: I gɛt
folded.object: raty fɔ sho

spans.text: I gɛt di raty fɔ sho, tɔk bɔt, fala ɔ ivin tich wetin i biliv to ɔda pɔsin dɛn, ilɛk usay ɔ uskayn we i pas di wɔd.

folded.id: i ikwal|ɛn|gɛt di sem rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin ɔloba di wɔl
folded.subject: i ikwal
folded.object: gɛt di sem rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin ɔloba di wɔl

spans.text: Soso we if wi sabi ɛn gri se if ɔlman gɛt insɛf yon rɛspɛkt, i ikwal ɛn gɛt di sem rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin ɔloba di wɔl, dɛn di wanol wɔ1 sɛf go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis; as tiŋ dɛn we wikɛd pasmak dɔn apin bikɔs pipul dɛm nɔ wan fɔ gri se ɔlman ikwal.
ɛvribɔdi ikwal ɛn di lɔ fɔ ebul protɛkt ɛniwan wantɛm we ɔda pipul dɛn na trit wan du am wetin in mɔtalman rayt nɔ gri fɔɔ if bad pipul se ɔda wan agens am.

folded.id: if i|wok|wit di gɔvamɛnt ɔ if i vot fɔ pipul dɛn we go wok wit di gɔvamɛnt
folded.subject: if i
folded.object: wit di gɔvamɛnt ɔ if i vot fɔ pipul dɛn we go wok wit di gɔvamɛnt

spans.text: I kin du dis if i wok wit di gɔvamɛnt ɔ if i vot fɔ pipul dɛn we go wok wit di gɔvamɛnt.

folded.id: if|di|rizin we mek da pɔsin de wan kɔmɔt na in kɔntri go tap ɔdasay nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du with pɔlitiks
folded.subject: if
folded.object: rizin we mek da pɔsin de wan kɔmɔt na in kɔntri go tap ɔdasay nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du with pɔlitiks

spans.text: Bɔt, if di rizin we mek da pɔsin de wan kɔmɔt na in kɔntri go tap ɔdasay nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du with pɔlitiks, ɔ na tiŋ we di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn stetmɛnt de agens, dɛn i nɔ go gɛt da rayt de.

folded.id: ilɛk usay|ɔ|uskayn we i pas di wɔd
folded.subject: ilɛk usay
folded.object: uskayn we i pas di wɔd

spans.text: I gɛt di raty fɔ sho, tɔk bɔt, fala ɔ ivin tich wetin i biliv to ɔda pɔsin dɛn, ilɛk usay ɔ uskayn we i pas di wɔd.

folded.id: in grup|ɔ|chɔch ɛn ivin di we aw i fil bɔt gɔd
folded.subject: in grup
folded.object: chɔch ɛn ivin di we aw i fil bɔt Gɔd

spans.text: ɛvibɔdi gɛt rayt fɔ tink aw i want, fil aw i want bɔt ɛnitin we de apin ɛnisay, ɛn jɔyn ɛni grup ɔ chɔch ɔɛni ɔda Gɔd wok fɔ prez Gɔd di we i fil, igen sɛf, i fri fɔ chenj in grup ɔ chɔch ɛn ivin di we aw i fil bɔt Gɔd; pantap dat, i fri fɔ wɔship in wangren ɔ wit ɔda pipul dɛn na pɔblik ɔ prayvet.

folded.id: in gudnɛm|ɔ|in rɛspɛkt
folded.subject: in gudnɛm
folded.object: in rɛspɛkt

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt rayt fɔ intafia as i lɛk wit ɔda pɔsin in kolat, in fambul, in om ɛn in lɛta dɛn we ɔda pipul rayt to am, ɔ ivin tray fɔ pwɛl in gudnɛm ɔ in rɛspɛkt.

folded.id: in om|ɛn|in lɛta dɛn we ɔda pipul rayt to am
folded.subject: in om
folded.object: in lɛta dɛn we ɔda pipul rayt to am

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ gɛt rayt fɔ intafia as i lɛk wit ɔda pɔsin in kolat, in fambul, in om ɛn in lɛta dɛn we ɔda pipul rayt to am, ɔ ivin tray fɔ pwɛl in gudnɛm ɔ in rɛspɛkt.

folded.id: in wangren|ɔ|wit ɔda pipul dɛn na pɔblik ɔ prayvet
folded.subject: in wangren
folded.object: wit ɔda pipul dɛn na pɔblik ɔ prayvet

spans.text: ɛvibɔdi gɛt rayt fɔ tink aw i want, fil aw i want bɔt ɛnitin we de apin ɛnisay, ɛn jɔyn ɛni grup ɔ chɔch ɔɛni ɔda Gɔd wok fɔ prez Gɔd di we i fil, igen sɛf, i fri fɔ chenj in grup ɔ chɔch ɛn ivin di we aw i fil bɔt Gɔd; pantap dat, i fri fɔ wɔship in wangren ɔ wit ɔda pipul dɛn na pɔblik ɔ prayvet.

folded.id: ivin if|di|mared brok sɛf
folded.subject: ivin if
folded.object: mared brok sɛf

spans.text: Dɛn fɔ gɛt di sem rayt as maredman ɛn mareduman, ivin if di mared brok sɛf.

folded.id: jel|ɔ|drɛb ɛni pɔsin kɔmɔt na in yon kɔntri jɛs bikɛs i fil fɔ du so
folded.subject: jel
folded.object: drɛb ɛni pɔsin kɔmɔt na in yon kɔntri jɛs bikɛs i fil fɔ du so

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ arɛst, jel ɔ drɛb ɛni pɔsin kɔmɔt na in yon kɔntri jɛs bikɛs i fil fɔ du so.

folded.id: jɔstis|ɛn|pis
folded.subject: jɔstis
folded.object: pis

spans.text: Soso we if wi sabi ɛn gri se if ɔlman gɛt insɛf yon rɛspɛkt, i ikwal ɛn gɛt di sem rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin ɔloba di wɔl, dɛn di wanol wɔ1 sɛf go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis; as tiŋ dɛn we wikɛd pasmak dɔn apin bikɔs pipul dɛm nɔ wan fɔ gri se ɔlman ikwal.
Na semweso di mɛmba kɔntri dɛn na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn dɔn gri fɔ jɔynan ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis sote go.
Fɔ mek dis wanwɔd ol wata ɔloba di wɔl, ɛvribɔdi fɔɔndastand wetin dɛn rayt ɛn dɛn fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis yaso min.

Dis stetmɛnt bɔt di rayt we ɔlman ɔlsay na di wɔl fɔ gɛt, fɔ bi sem fɔɔl kanaba pipul dɛn na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa, fɔ mek shɔ se dnsɛf ɛn dɛn dɛnlan am, dɛn sabi am ɛn de fala wetin i se so dat ɔLoba di wɔl pipul dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis.

folded.id: kanaba pipul|dɛn|na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa
folded.subject: kanaba pipul
folded.object: na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa

spans.text: Dis stetmɛnt bɔt di rayt we ɔlman ɔlsay na di wɔl fɔ gɛt, fɔ bi sem fɔɔl kanaba pipul dɛn na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa, fɔ mek shɔ se dnsɛf ɛn dɛn dɛnlan am, dɛn sabi am ɛn de fala wetin i se so dat ɔLoba di wɔl pipul dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis.
Di pipul dɛn go sho wetin dɛn want we dɛn wan we dɔn big du fɔ vot go vot na jɛnaral ilɛkshɔn frɔm tɛm to tɛm.

folded.id: kɔla|ɔ|rilijɔn
folded.subject: kɔla
folded.object: rilijɔn

spans.text: ɛNi man ɛn uman we dɔn ɔfej, no mata if dɛn tu nɔ to di sem trayb, kɔla ɔ rilijɔn, gɛt di rayt fɔ mared, bɔn pikin ɛn bigin dɛn yon famili.

folded.id: kɔntri we|di|pɔsin bɔn sɛf nɔ fɔ bi baria na in we
folded.subject: kɔntri we
folded.object: pɔsin bɔn sɛf nɔ fɔ bi baria na in we

spans.text: Pantap dat, di kɔntri we di pɔsin bɔn sɛf nɔ fɔ bi baria na in we.

folded.id: kristiɛn|ɔ|muslim
folded.subject: kristiɛn
folded.object: muslim

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi fɔ gɛt di sem rayt ɛn fridom we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, nɔ mata wɛda in na wetman ɔ blakman, man ɔ uman, bukman ɔ yu nɔ sabi rid ɛn rayt, poman ɔ mɔniman, kristiɛn ɔ muslim.

folded.id: lɛ kolat|ɛn|frɛnship de bitwin neshɔn ɛn neshɔn dɛn
folded.subject: lɛ kolat
folded.object: frɛnship de bitwin neshɔn ɛn neshɔn dɛn

spans.text: Na semweso i gud fɔ lɛ kolat ɛn frɛnship de bitwin neshɔn ɛn neshɔn dɛn.

folded.id: lɛf wit|di|kot naw fɔ pruv se i du am na pɔblik trayal usay insɛf go gɛt in yon lɔya dɛn we go fɛt in kes fɔ am
folded.subject: lɛf wit
folded.object: kot naw fɔ pruv se i du am na pɔblik trayal usay insɛf go gɛt in yon Lɔya dɛn we go fɛt in kes fɔ am

spans.text: I go lɛf wit di kot naw fɔ pruv se i du am na pɔblik trayal usay insɛf go gɛt in yon Lɔya dɛn we go fɛt in kes fɔ am.

folded.id: man|ɔ|uman
folded.subject: man
folded.object: uman

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi fɔ gɛt di sem rayt ɛn fridom we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, nɔ mata wɛda in na wetman ɔ blakman, man ɔ uman, bukman ɔ yu nɔ sabi rid ɛn rayt, poman ɔ mɔniman, kristiɛn ɔ muslim.

folded.id: mata if|dɛn|tu nɔ to di sem trayb
folded.subject: mata if
folded.object: tu nɔ to di sem trayb

folded.id: mek pipul|dɛn|rɛspɛkt am as mɔtalman ɛnisay na di wɔl ɛn
folded.subject: mek pipul
folded.object: rɛspɛkt am as mɔtalman ɛnisay na di wɔl ɛn

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi gɛt rayt fɔ mek pipul dɛn rɛspɛkt am as mɔtalman ɛnisay na di wɔl ɛn, sɛf, fɔ mek di lɔɛp am gɛt dis rɛspɛkt.

folded.id: mɛmba ɔf|ɛni|grup we i chuz wans nɔmɔ den nɔ de du ɛnitiŋ de fɔ briŋ ambɔg ɔ trɔbul na di kɔntri
folded.subject: mɛmba ɔf
folded.object: grup we i chuz wans nɔmɔ den nɔ de du ɛnitiŋ de fɔ briŋ ambɔg ɔ trɔbul na di kɔntri

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi fri fɔ bi mɛmba ɔf ɛni grup we i chuz wans nɔmɔ den nɔ de du ɛnitiŋ de fɔ briŋ ambɔg ɔ trɔbul na di kɔntri.

folded.id: na bɔdi|ɔ|shem sote i lɔs da in yon yon rɛspɛkt
folded.subject: na bɔdi
folded.object: shem sote i lɔs da in yon yon rɛspɛkt

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ mek in kɔmpin sɔfa bita wikɛd pen na bɔdi ɔ shem sote i lɔs da in yon yon rɛspɛkt.

folded.id: na semweso|di|mɛmba kɔntri dɛn na di yunaytɛd neshɔn dɔn gri fɔ jɔynan ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn go gɛt fridɔm
folded.subject: Na semweso
folded.object: mɛmba kɔntri dɛn na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn dɔn gri fɔ jɔynan ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn go gɛt fridɔm

spans.text: Na semweso di mɛmba kɔntri dɛn na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn dɔn gri fɔ jɔynan ɛn mek shɔ se dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis sote go.

folded.id: na wetman|ɔ|blakman
folded.subject: na wetman
folded.object: blakman

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi fɔ gɛt di sem rayt ɛn fridom we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, nɔ mata wɛda in na wetman ɔ blakman, man ɔ uman, bukman ɔ yu nɔ sabi rid ɛn rayt, poman ɔ mɔniman, kristiɛn ɔ muslim.

folded.id: ɔɛniwan pan|di|kɔntri dɛn na di yunaytɛd neshɔn ɛn tɔn bak kam na in yon kɔntri we i pliz
folded.subject: ɔɛniwan pan
folded.object: kɔntri dɛn na di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn ɛn tɔn bak kam na in yon kɔntri we i pliz

folded.id: ɔɔda kɔntri|dɛn|na di wɔl
folded.subject: ɔɔda kɔntri
folded.object: na di wɔl

spans.text: Nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ pas jɔjmɛnt se pɔsin gilti ɔ ipɔnish da pɔsin de fɔ lɛk big ɔfens we pas wetin i du ɛ sɛf, we nɔtɔɔfɛns insay in yon kɔntri ɔɔda kɔntri dɛn na di wɔl.

folded.subject: poman
folded.object: mɔniman

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi fɔ gɛt di sem rayt ɛn fridom we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, nɔ mata wɛda in na wetman ɔ blakman, man ɔ uman, bukman ɔ yu nɔ sabi rid ɛn rayt, poman ɔ mɔniman, kristiɛn ɔ muslim.

folded.subject: protɛkt am
folded.object: gi am chans fɔ divɛlɔp insɛf ɛnisay ɛn bi sɔmbdi wit rɛspɛkt ɛn we go ebul insɛf pan wok ɔ biznɛs ɔ stɔdi te in kɔntri kin si am as wan pɔsin we fɔ abop pan

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi gɛt rayt fɔɛkspɛkt in kɔntri fɔ protɛkt am ɛn gi am chans fɔ divɛlɔp insɛf ɛnisay ɛn bi sɔmbdi wit rɛspɛkt ɛn we go ebul insɛf pan wok ɔ biznɛs ɔ stɔdi te in kɔntri kin si am as wan pɔsin we fɔ abop pan.

folded.subject: rayt lɛk
folded.object: ɔda pɔsin na di bɛst divɛlop kɔntri na di wɔl

spans.text: I fɔ gɛt ikwal rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin na di bɛst divɛlop kɔntri na di wɔl.

folded.object: dɛn dɛnlan am

spans.text: Dis stetmɛnt bɔt di rayt we ɔlman ɔlsay na di wɔl fɔ gɛt, fɔ bi sem fɔɔl kanaba pipul dɛn na ɔl di kɔntri dɛn ɛn dat ɛvribɔdi ɛn patikla di wan dɛn we gɛt pawa, fɔ mek shɔ se dnsɛf ɛn dɛn dɛnlan am, dɛn sabi am ɛn de fala wetin i se so dat ɔLoba di wɔl pipul dɛn go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis.

spans.text: ɛnibɔdi we tink se in layf de pan denja gɛt di rayt fɔ aks mek dɛn alaw am, ɛn in fɔ gɛt da pamishɔn de fɔ tap na ɛni ɔda kɔntri na di wɔl.

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi we tink se dɛn dɔn go agens in rayt we dis stetmɛnt tɔk bɔt, fɔ ebul gɛt ɔl di ɛp we i nid frɔm ɛni kotos we gɛt pawa na in kɔntri.

spans.text: Di tiŋ we di kɔmɔn man want pas ɔltin na di wɔl tide na fɔ mek ɛvribɔdi ebul fɔ se wetin i fil, ɔ tink bay aw tiŋ de bi, fɔ biliv wetin i want fɔ biliv ɛn gɛt bɛnifit frɔm ɔl wetin i nid, wit kolat.

folded.id: tiŋ we|di|yunaytɛd neshɔn stetmɛnt de agens
folded.subject: tiŋ we
folded.object: Yunaytɛd Neshɔn stetmɛnt de agens

spans.text: Bɔt, if di rizin we mek da pɔsin de wan kɔmɔt na in kɔntri go tap ɔdasay nɔ gɛt natin fɔ du with pɔlitiks, ɔ na tiŋ we di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn stetmɛnt de agens, dɛn i nɔ go gɛt da rayt de.

spans.text: ɛvribɔdi gɛt rayt fɔ fɔrm tred Yuniɔn ɔ jɔyn an as wokman ɔ wokuman fɔ mek nɔbɔdi nɔ tinap pan dɛn rayt na di wokples.

spans.text: Fɔ mek dis wanwɔd ol wata ɔloba di wɔl, ɛvribɔdi fɔɔndastand wetin dɛn rayt ɛn dɛn fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis yaso min.

spans.text: We di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn dɛn sɛf si dis nain mek dɛn put am tranga wan na dɛn chata se ɔl mɔtalman ɔlsay na di wɔl ikwal, dɛn gɛt dɛnsɛf sɛf yon rɛspɛkt we nɔbɔdi nɔ fɔ fɔmful wit.

folded.object: na man ɔ uman

spans.text: Wɛda dɛn na man ɔ uman, diffrɛns nɔ fɔ de, ɛn di Yunaytɛd Neshɔn dɔ mekop dɛn maynd fɔ mek ɔlman liv with kolat ɛn rɛspɛkt usay i de ɛn gɛt itwal chans fɔ du wetin dɛn sabi fɔ du.

spans.text: Soso we if wi sabi ɛn gri se if ɔlman gɛt insɛf yon rɛspɛkt, i ikwal ɛn gɛt di sem rayt lɛk ɛni ɔda pɔsin ɔloba di wɔl, dɛn di wanol wɔ1 sɛf go gɛt fridɔm, jɔstis ɛn pis; as tiŋ dɛn we wikɛd pasmak dɔn apin bikɔs pipul dɛm nɔ wan fɔ gri se ɔlman ikwal.

spans.text: If man fɔ liv wit kolat ɛn nɔ gɛt fɔ de fɛt fɔ in yon yon rayt, dɛn i impɔtant fɔ mek di lɔ protɛkt da rayt de;
